# benign-notes-app

A deliberately boring fixture: a small notes client. Used by the
[cleanroom](https://github.com/amanvicky/cleanroom) test suite to make sure
the triage engine does NOT raise scored findings on ordinary code that simply
uses HTTP and reads an environment variable.

"""A deliberately boring notes app — cleanroom's 'clean' fixture.

Uses the network and reads one environment variable, like most real apps.
Contains nothing the triage engine should score.
"""

import os

import requests

API_URL = "https://api.example.com/notes"


def fetch_notes():
    base = os.environ.get("NOTES_API_URL", API_URL)
    resp = requests.get(base, timeout=10)
    return resp.json()


def add_note(text):
    resp = requests.post(API_URL, json={"text": text}, timeout=10)
    return resp.status_code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("notes fixture: %d notes" % len(fetch_notes()))

"""Notes GUI — cleanroom's tkinter demo fixture.

On the live runner this renders on the app screen (the runner installs a
virtual tkinter — a subset rendered as real HTML widgets). On a real PC it
opens a normal tkinter window.
"""

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("Notes")

    tk.Label(root, text="My notes", font=("Helvetica", 16, "bold")).pack(pady=6)

    row = tk.Frame(root)
    row.pack(fill="x", padx=10)
    note = tk.Entry(row, width=32)
    note.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)

    def add():
        text = note.get().strip()
        if not text:
            messagebox.showinfo("Notes", "type a note first")
            return
        notes.insert("end", text)
        note.delete(0, "end")
        count.set("%d notes" % notes.size())

    tk.Button(row, text="add", command=add).pack(side="left", padx=6)

    notes = tk.Listbox(root, height=6)
    notes.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=10, pady=8)

    count = tk.StringVar(value="0 notes")
    tk.Label(root, textvariable=count).pack(pady=4)

    tk.Button(root, text="quit", command=root.destroy).pack(pady=6)

    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
